The '''Expansionary Fleet's charter''', alternatively referred to as the '''charter of the Expansionary Defense Fleet''' by [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], was a set of guidelines that governed the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]]. The charter only permitted observation and exploration in the regions around the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="OF" />

Following the [[Destruction of Special Task Force One|destruction]] of [[Special Task Force One]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrass," of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] arranged a meeting between [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] at her quarters in the upper level of the [[Crustai asteroid base]], where Car'das tried to stall Ar'alani by stating that Thrawn acted within the scope of the Expansionary Fleet's charter and fought only in self-defense. While Thrass recited the charter, Ar'alani countered that Thrawn violated the [[defensive-only doctrine]].<ref name="OF" />
